description.value: A full-service waterfront hotel in North Vancouver, the Pinnacle Hotel at the Pier sits steps from the famous Lonsdale Quay with views of the harbour and North Shore mountains. The hotel offers elegantly appointed rooms, two on-site restaurants (The Lobby Restaurant & Lounge and Pier 7 Restaurant & Bar), a health club, and a pool. Its central location near the Quay Market & Food Hall and proximity to North Shore breweries make it a well-situated urban base for touring cyclists.
